semantically_equivalent_models.justification: 'Parallel mentoring' shares the 'teacher' or 'mentoring' theme with the 'mean teacher' model, however, it is not semantically equivalent. 'Parallel mentoring' focuses on mentor-mentee relationships in a concurrent framework, whereas the 'mean teacher' framework is particularly designed for semi-supervised learning and involves the averaging of model weights.

'Tri-mentoring' shares a similar thematic focus on mentorship as 'mean teacher.' However, it is not directly semantically equivalent. 'Tri-mentoring' involves a threefold approach to mentorship, which is not identical to the 'mean teacher,' which focuses on semi-supervised learning by leveraging a student-teacher model with exponential moving averages of the teacher's predictions.
